# agentic-documents

Write documents with people and agents in real time.

Keywords: documents,editor,rich-text,tiptap,collaboration,agents,mcp,cli,cloudflare.

- SDK: import { summarizeText, dispatchText } from "agentic-documents".
- CLI: agentic-documents summary --text "...".
- MCP: run agentic-documents mcp, then call summarize_text.
